difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, geometric reducedness of the fibre over the generic point forces geometric reducedness of every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof reduces to the affine situation, expresses geometric reducedness of the generic fibre by the absence of nilpotents after base change to the algebraic closure, and then spreads that condition to a neighbourhood using finite presentation. Producing a witness that survives the base change to the algebraic closure and then to the spread is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7227-7256.
